ios.desc:
Gyroscope is not just an app, but a new operating system for the human body.

You’ll be able to see everything about your biology, and update your internal systems for our modern world.

Better nutrition, better exercise, better living with AI.


C A M E R A

With the world’s first Health Camera, tracking your life is as simple as taking a photo. 

Use the app to take a photo of everything you eat (and drink) to get realtime and accurate data. Gyroscope is designed to be the most accurate and convenient way to track your eating — combining photos, text labels, scale data, nutrition labels and your personalizations for easy and intuitive tracking that learns with you.


U P G R A D E

Gyroscope is designed for maximum privacy and quality.

There are no ads, and your data is never sold. Just one simple membership powers the service for everyone.

Everyone can start with the 4 essential trackers (Places, Mood, Sleep and Food), or join premium to unlock all trackers and coaching.

Gyroscope One adds hundreds of trackers and integrations to see everything in one place: nutrients, fasting, meditation, workouts, travel, sleep, glucose, productivity. 

You can automatically sync with thousands of devices like Apple Watch, wearables, smart mattresses, scales, glucose monitors, and more. 

And now you’re not alone. Your AI coach in the app helps you make sense of it all with insights, notifications, and custom reports tailored to you and your goals.


R E V I E W S

“Gyroscope is the only product that makes tracking my life easy. With a glance I can tell what I'm excelling at, and what I need to work on. I don't go a day without checking the app.” – Brandon

“Tracking my life in gyroscope helped me lose 75lbs!”

“The insights I get using Gyroscope are priceless. Every day I am able to make more informed decisions that make me a happier and healthier person.” – Chris

“Love the ability to track my location without sacrificing my privacy to Facebook and Google.” – Sawyer

“I think I've been using Gyroscope for a while now and it's by far one of the subscriptions I have that brings me more joy.” – Lucas


M E M B E R S H I P

Create an account to start with the basics, including free quizzes and consultations, 4 complimentary trackers, and 30 days of storage.

Upgrade to Gyroscope One membership for hundreds of more trackers, AI coach, unlimited storage, fat loss protocol, integrations, and more.


Y O U R   A C C O U N T

Gyroscope requires an account to sync and view
